Package com.univalle.fpoe.escriturarapida.event

Interface GameListener

All Known Implementing Classes:
GameListenerAdapter
public interface GameListener
Listener for the events of an "Escritura Rapida" match.

The GameModel fires these events and the controller implements them to update the user interface.

Version:
1.0
Author:
Santiago Ruiz Vanegas

    • onLevelStart

      void onLevelStart(int level, String word, double timeLimit)
      Called when a new level starts.
      Parameters:
      level - the level that starts
      word - the word or phrase the player must type
      timeLimit - the time limit for this level, in seconds

    • onLevelSuccess

      void onLevelSuccess(int level)
      Called when the player types the word correctly.
      Parameters:
      level - the level that was completed

    • onLevelFailure

      void onLevelFailure(int level, String reason)
      Called when an answer is wrong. If there is still time left the player can keep trying; if the time ran out, onGameOver(int, double) is called right after.
      Parameters:
      level - the current level
      reason - message describing the failure

    • onGameOver

      void onGameOver(int levelsCompleted, double timeRemaining)
      Called when the match ends because the time ran out without a correct answer.
      Parameters:
      levelsCompleted - levels completed in the match
      timeRemaining - seconds left on the clock
